selection_rule: From the first 12 sorted public train instructions: first all-target scenario and first cross-app set reconciliation scenario; take _1 only. No solution, metadata, evaluator or model outcome used.
server_lease_basis: Existing supervisor was launched with --max-seconds 14400; reserve 180 seconds beyond both runs. Do not begin if this lease is too short.
scope: Two development tasks, one seed each, native public schemas and ordered multiple calls. No new method or original-author score reproduction.
discovery_policy: Initially api_docs and supervisor schemas. A requested app description exposes that public app; individual API documentation exposes that API. New schemas apply on the next model response. No answer-based selection or silent top-k pruning.
changes_from_P6: API-specific native function schemas instead of a generic app/api/args wrapper.
Multiple independent function calls are processed in order, with per-operation recording and an explicit API request cap.
Schemas discovered from public documentation requests add to subsequent model input and total token cost.
Prompt names and multi-call instructions are adjusted; memory remains full history.
interpretation: This bundles interface changes; differences cannot be uniquely attributed to schemas or batching.
Task selection and adapter calibration used development observations; this is not an unseen test.
All schemas are preserved as distributed, including absence of a required field; API validation still runs.
Transport failure after dispatch has unknown effects and stops further calls without retries.
No original P6 or P7 trial is replaced. Official evaluation never reaches generation.
